title: Transcription engine
description: Which speech engine transcribes each kind of meeting, and whether a Virtual Participant separates voices.
appliesText: A saved change applies to meetings that start at least 30 seconds after the save; a meeting already running keeps its settings.

streamingEngineMicrovm.title: Stream Audio/Video, Chrome extension and Desktop Capture
streamingEngineMicrovm.description: Engine for streamed meetings. Redaction, custom vocabularies or language identification keep Transcribe.

virtualParticipantEngineMicrovm.title: Virtual Participants
virtualParticipantEngineMicrovm.description: Engine for Virtual Participants. Redaction, custom vocabularies or language identification keep Transcribe.

diarizeVirtualParticipant.title: Virtual Participant voice separation
diarizeVirtualParticipant.description: Tell apart the voices behind each attendee, such as people in a conference room.
